rows.name: Intimidate
rows.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

rows.name: Grassy Surge
rows.description: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

rows.name: Unburden
rows.description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

rows.name: Defiant
rows.description: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

rows.name: Rough Skin
rows.description: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

rows.name: Lightning Rod
rows.description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

rows.name: Good as Gold
rows.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

rows.name: Levitate
rows.description: Damage dealing Ground-type moves have no effect on this Pokémon. Cannot be trapped by Arena Trap ability. Takes no damage from Spikes.

rows.name: Aerilate
rows.description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

rows.name: Psychic Surge
rows.description: Turns the entire field into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

rows.name: No Guard
rows.description: The accuracy of all moves known by this Pokémon and all Pokémon targeting this Pokémon raises to 100%

rows.name: Tough Claws
rows.description: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

rows.name: Drizzle
rows.description: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

rows.name: Adaptability
rows.description: Increases the Same Type Attack Bonus from *1.5 to *2.

rows.name: Drought
rows.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

rows.name: Blaze
rows.description: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

rows.name: Pixilate
rows.description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

rows.name: Flower Veil
rows.description: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

rows.name: Stamina
rows.description: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

rows.name: Prankster
rows.description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon's status moves by 1 stage. However, the Pokémon's status moves no longer work against Dark-type Pokémon.

rows.name: Armor Tail
rows.description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

rows.name: Rock Head
rows.description: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

rows.name: Fairy Aura
rows.description: Powers up every Pokémon in play's Fairy-type moves by 33%

rows.name: Emergency Exit
rows.description: The Pokémon switches out of battle when its HP drops to 1/2 or less of its max.

rows.name: Competitive
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

rows.name: Flame Body
rows.description: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

rows.name: Cursed Body
rows.description: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

rows.name: Contrary
rows.description: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

rows.name: Sand Stream
rows.description: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

rows.name: Snow Warning
rows.description: Snowstorm blows when the Pokémon enters battle. As of X & Y, this lasts 5 turns.

rows.name: Chlorophyll
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

rows.name: Flash Fire
rows.description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

rows.name: Hospitality
rows.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

rows.name: Inner Focus
rows.description: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

rows.name: Swift Swim
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

rows.name: Sand Rush
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

rows.name: Trace
rows.description: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.

rows.name: Shadow Tag
rows.description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

rows.name: Liquid Voice
rows.description: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

rows.name: Clear Body
rows.description: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

rows.name: Poison Touch
rows.description: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

rows.name: Multiscale
rows.description: Reduces damage afflicted to the Pokémon by 50% if at maximum HP

rows.name: Unnerve
rows.description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

rows.name: Toxic Debris
rows.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

rows.name: Soundproof
rows.description: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

rows.name: Torrent
rows.description: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

rows.name: Sharpness
rows.description: Powers up slicing moves.

rows.name: Aura Guard
rows.description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from contact moves.

rows.name: Electric Surge
rows.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

rows.name: Sheer Force
rows.description: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

rows.name: Magic Bounce
rows.description: Reflects non-attacking moves used on the Pokémon back to the attacking Pokémon

rows.name: Mirror Armor
rows.description: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

rows.name: Speed Boost
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat by 1 stage at the end of every turn. The Speed stat will not be boosted on the turn that the Pokémon switches into battle.

rows.name: Thermal Exchange
rows.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Fire-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by 1 stage. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

rows.name: Iron Fist
rows.description: The power of punching moves is increased by 20%. This stacks with

rows.name: Regenerator
rows.description: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

rows.name: Solid Rock
rows.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

rows.name: Mega Launcher
rows.description: Powers up pulse moves.

rows.name: Huge Power
rows.description: The Pokémon's Attack stat is doubled while it has this ability.

rows.name: Compound Eyes
rows.description: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

rows.name: Infiltrator
rows.description: The protections and stat boosts caused by the moves Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen and Safeguard by the opponent are ignored.

rows.name: Scrappy
rows.description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

rows.name: Solar Power
rows.description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

rows.name: Synchronize
rows.description: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

rows.name: Rain Dish
rows.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

rows.name: Gale Wings
rows.description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

rows.name: Hyper Cutter
rows.description: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

rows.name: Technician
rows.description: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

rows.name: Damp
rows.description: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

rows.name: Overgrow
rows.description: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

rows.name: Friend Guard
rows.description: Reduces damage dealt to allies.

rows.name: Justified
rows.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

rows.name: Spicy Spray
rows.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

rows.name: Thick Fat
rows.description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

rows.name: Cloud Nine
rows.description: Eliminates the effects of weather.

rows.name: Fire Mane
rows.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

rows.name: Mold Breaker
rows.description: The Pokémon's moves are not affected by foe’s abilities during battle

rows.name: Moody
rows.description: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.

rows.name: Protean
rows.description: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.

rows.name: Pressure
rows.description: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

rows.name: Stance Change
rows.description: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

rows.name: Telepathy
rows.description: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

rows.name: Bulletproof
rows.description: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

rows.name: Illusion
rows.description: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.

rows.name: Limber
rows.description: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

rows.name: Sand Force
rows.description: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

rows.name: Shell Armor
rows.description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

rows.name: Snow Cloak
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

rows.name: Unaware
rows.description: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

rows.name: Mega Sol
rows.description: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

rows.name: Queenly Majesty
rows.description: Opponents are unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

rows.name: Sturdy
rows.description: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

rows.name: Disguise
rows.description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

rows.name: Oblivious
rows.description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

rows.name: Punk Rock
rows.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's sound-based moves by 30% and halves the damage the Pokémon takes from sound-based moves.

rows.name: Sand Veil
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms.

rows.name: Static
rows.description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

rows.name: Weak Armor
rows.description: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

rows.name: Moxie
rows.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

rows.name: Super Luck
rows.description: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

rows.name: Volt Absorb
rows.description: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

rows.name: Sniper
rows.description: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

rows.name: Water Bubble
rows.description: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.

rows.name: Leaf Guard
rows.description: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

rows.name: Pickpocket
rows.description: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

rows.name: Stalwart
rows.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

rows.name: Berserk
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.

rows.name: Cute Charm
rows.description: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.

rows.name: Eelevate
rows.description: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

rows.name: Filter
rows.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

rows.name: Frisk
rows.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

rows.name: Magic Guard
rows.description: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

rows.name: Magician
rows.description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

rows.name: Natural Cure
rows.description: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

rows.name: Own Tempo
rows.description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

rows.name: Parental Bond
rows.description: Parent and child each attacks.

rows.name: Reckless
rows.description: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

rows.name: Unseen Fist
rows.description: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected.

rows.name: Zero to Hero
rows.description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

rows.name: Dragonize
rows.description: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

rows.name: Fur Coat
rows.description: Halves the damage from physical moves.

rows.name: Healer
rows.description: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

rows.name: Imposter
rows.description: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

rows.name: Libero
rows.description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once per time the Pokémon enters battle.

rows.name: Magma Armor
rows.description: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

rows.name: Steadfast
rows.description: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

rows.name: Supreme Overlord
rows.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

rows.name: Symbiosis
rows.description: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

rows.name: Anger Point
rows.description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

rows.name: Aroma Veil
rows.description: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.

rows.name: Corrosion
rows.description: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

rows.name: Earth Eater
rows.description: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

rows.name: Electromorphosis
rows.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

rows.name: Keen Eye
rows.description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

rows.name: Marvel Scale
rows.description: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.

rows.name: Overcoat
rows.description: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

rows.name: Piercing Drill
rows.description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

rows.name: Sap Sipper
rows.description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.

rows.name: Skill Link
rows.description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

rows.name: Strong Jaw
rows.description: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

rows.name: Surge Surfer
rows.description: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

rows.name: Swarm
rows.description: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

rows.name: Analytic
rows.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

rows.name: Big Pecks
rows.description: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.

rows.name: Cud Chew
rows.description: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

rows.name: Dry Skin
rows.description: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

rows.name: Guts
rows.description: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

rows.name: Harvest
rows.description: May create another Berry after one is used.

rows.name: Heatproof
rows.description: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

rows.name: Heavy Metal
rows.description: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.

rows.name: Hunger Switch
rows.description: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

rows.name: Hustle
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

rows.name: Ice Body
rows.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

rows.name: Insomnia
rows.description: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

rows.name: Liquid Ooze
rows.description: When the Pokémon is hit by an HP-absorbing move, the attacker does not restore HP but instead takes damage equal to the amount of HP it would have restored.

rows.name: Merciless
rows.description: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

rows.name: Mummy
rows.description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.

rows.name: Poison Point
rows.description: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

rows.name: Purifying Salt
rows.description: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

rows.name: Refrigerate
rows.description: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

rows.name: Screen Cleaner
rows.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

rows.name: Seed Sower
rows.description: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon takes damage from moves.

rows.name: Steely Spirit
rows.description: Boosts the power of the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies by 50%.

rows.name: Sweet Veil
rows.description: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

rows.name: Wandering Spirit
rows.description: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

rows.name: Water Absorb
rows.description: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

rows.name: White Smoke
rows.description: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

rows.name: Aftermath
rows.description: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

rows.name: Anticipation
rows.description: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

rows.name: Battle Armor
rows.description: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

rows.name: Cheek Pouch
rows.description: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

rows.name: Curious Medicine
rows.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

rows.name: Early Bird
rows.description: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

rows.name: Effect Spore
rows.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

rows.name: Fluffy
rows.description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

rows.name: Forecast
rows.description: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

rows.name: Forewarn
rows.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

rows.name: Gluttony
rows.description: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

rows.name: Gooey
rows.description: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

rows.name: Grass Pelt
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat by 50% on Grassy Terrain.

rows.name: Guard Dog
rows.description: Intimidate does not work on the Pokémon. Instead, it boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat by 1 stage. The Pokémon is also unaffected by the moves and held items of other Pokémon that would force it to switch out of battle.

rows.name: Hydration
rows.description: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

rows.name: Illuminate
rows.description: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

rows.name: Immunity
rows.description: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

rows.name: Innards Out
rows.description: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

rows.name: Klutz
rows.description: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

rows.name: Light Metal
rows.description: Halves the Pokémon's weight.

rows.name: Long Reach
rows.description: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

rows.name: Mimicry
rows.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

rows.name: Minus
rows.description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

rows.name: Motor Drive
rows.description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

rows.name: Opportunist
rows.description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

rows.name: Pickup
rows.description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

rows.name: Plus
rows.description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

rows.name: Poison Heal
rows.description: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

rows.name: Pure Power
rows.description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

rows.name: Quick Draw
rows.description: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

rows.name: Quick Feet
rows.description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

rows.name: Rattled
rows.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move or when it is on the receiving end of Intimidate, its Speed stat is boosted by 1 stage.

rows.name: Receiver
rows.description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

rows.name: Ripen
rows.description: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

rows.name: Rivalry
rows.description: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

rows.name: Run Away
rows.description: Enables the Pokémon to ignore any effects that would usually prevent it from switching out of battle and being replaced by another party Pokémon.

rows.name: Sand Spit
rows.description: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

rows.name: Shed Skin
rows.description: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

rows.name: Shield Dust
rows.description: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

rows.name: Slush Rush
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

rows.name: Stakeout
rows.description: Doubles the power of the Pokémon's moves when it attacks targets that have just switched into battle.

rows.name: Stall
rows.description: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.

rows.name: Stench
rows.description: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

rows.name: Sticky Hold
rows.description: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

rows.name: Suction Cups
rows.description: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

rows.name: Supersweet Syrup
rows.description: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

rows.name: Tangled Feet
rows.description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

rows.name: Vital Spirit
rows.description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
